rules: World fall-through checks use deterministic authored anchors, blocking-ground evidence, falling state and bounded displacement; never a universal Z<0 rule.
Navigation tests use deterministic routes, not random wandering.
Memory/hitch thresholds come from target-device evidence; time dilation is not treated as equivalent to real-duration soak.
Animation/T-pose gates apply only to actors declared production-skeletal-ready.
Headless asset/shader checks never promote visual acceptance.

material-slot and shader compile error guards
exact-SHA machine-readable and human-readable QA report
evidence_boundary: STATIC-VALIDATED only until exact-head UE4.27.2 compile and Automation Framework execution succeed.
